channel.title: Newswire Hollywood
channel.description: Breaking entertainment industry news from Los Angeles - film, television, music, deals and the business behind the business.

item.title: Freda Payne stopped time at Catalina: a sold-out night with the legendary ladies of song
item.dc:creator: By the Music Desk, Newswire Hollywood
item.description: Nine women, one voice, and a room that would not let her go. Freda Payne's tribute to the ladies of jazz played to a full house on Sunset on VMAs weekend — and she knew half of the women she was singing about.

item.title: PRESS RELEASE: Freda Payne's “Legendary Ladies of Song” plays to a sold-out Catalina Jazz Club
item.dc:creator: Supplied by the production
item.description: Don B. Welch presents the legendary Freda Payne in a sold-out tribute to nine women who built American jazz and pop, staged on Sunset Boulevard on VMAs weekend.

item.title: Taylor Swift extends her Video of the Year record, Madonna wins seven and takes Artist of the Year
item.dc:creator: By the Music Desk, Newswire Hollywood
item.description: Taylor Swift won Video of the Year for a sixth time, a record nobody else is near. Madonna returned to the stage after twenty-three years and walked off with seven. Snoop Dogg hosted from the Peacock Theater.

item.title: VMAs return to Los Angeles Sunday: Madonna opens after 23 years, Snoop Dogg hosts, Nirvana takes the Vanguard
item.dc:creator: By the Music Desk, Newswire Hollywood
item.description: The 2026 MTV Video Music Awards air live from Los Angeles on Sunday. Madonna leads all nominees with thirteen and opens the show. Taylor Swift receives a newly created honor, and premieres a video during the broadcast.

item.title: Usher and Chris Brown take SoFi Stadium tonight, night two of three in Los Angeles
item.dc:creator: By the Music Desk, Newswire Hollywood
item.description: The co-headlining R&B Tour runs 33 stadium dates across North America. Los Angeles gets three of them — last night, tonight, and a return in November.

item.title: Paramount settles with 12 state attorneys general to save its $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery takeover
item.dc:creator: By the Deals Desk, Newswire Hollywood
item.description: The deal survives a lawsuit that could have killed it — at the cost of a film-output floor, a promise to run the two studios separately, and an FCC ruling that clears the merged company to be 49.5% foreign-owned.

item.title: Zach Cregger's 'Resident Evil' opens to a franchise-best $108 million
item.dc:creator: By the Film Desk, Newswire Hollywood
item.description: The video-game adaptation posts the biggest opening the series has ever had, and a long-dead 'World War Z' sequel comes back to life with Brad Pitt returning and Edward Berger directing.

item.title: Emmys 2026: the winners
item.dc:creator: By the Awards Desk, Newswire Hollywood
item.description: The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards aired Monday from the Peacock Theater, hosted by Mariska Hargitay. "Hacks" took Outstanding Comedy Series in its final season, Jean Smart and Matthew Rhys won lead acting categories, and the red carpet delivered on the archival-over-custom forecast.

item.title: Toronto opens with 'Being Heumann,' Sian Heder's follow-up to 'CODA'
item.dc:creator: By the Film Desk, Newswire Hollywood
item.description: The 51st Toronto International Film Festival opened September 10 with the world premiere of a biopic on disability rights activist Judy Heumann, from the director whose last film won Best Picture.

item.title: 'The Odyssey' breaks IMAX's all-time box office record
item.dc:creator: By the Deals Desk, Newswire Hollywood
item.description: $289 million in IMAX alone, passing Avatar's $270 million record, on the way to $1.627 billion worldwide - the highest-grossing R-rated film in history.

item.title: Sony Music Publishing, Warner Chappell sue Anthropic over song lyrics in AI training data
item.dc:creator: By the AI & Technology Desk, Newswire Hollywood
item.description: 35 music publishers filed suit August 28, alleging Claude was trained on copyrighted lyrics obtained by scraping and torrenting, seeking statutory damages of up to $150,000 per work. Filed, not resolved.

item.title: Freda Payne returns to Catalina with a tribute to the women who built the songbook
item.dc:creator: By the Music Desk, Newswire Hollywood
item.description: The two-time Grammy nominee brings Legendary Ladies of Jazz to Hollywood on September 26, with her son Gregory Abbott Jr. hosting and Thomasina Gross channeling Eartha Kitt.
